About.title: About Me
About.heading: Connecting Information Systems and IT Through Passionate Programming
About.description: I am an Information Systems graduate from Hasanuddin University (2022–2026), specializing in full-stack web development, mobile solutions, and data analytics. My technical foundation spans core languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, and C/C++, paired with modern web frameworks like Next.js, Svelte, Laravel, Express.js, and FastAPI. I am experienced in designing and testing RESTful APIs using Postman, managing databases across MySQL and MongoDB, and developing mobile applications using Flutter and Android Studio. Additionally, I leverage tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Blender, and Unity for data visualization, business intelligence, 3D modeling, and interactive augmented reality solutions.
